Behemoth: Throw the boulder instantly.

rampage.menu_description:
Become enraged, growing in size and altering Rampage's abilities for 10s. During this time he gains 200/450/700 maximum health and 5%(+10%) Movement Speed.

While Behemoth is active, Rampage restores 1.5/2.75/4% of his maximum health per second. This is increased by 4% for each Enemy Hero within a 1000 unit radius of Rampage.
